'''Braata''' was one of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]], ancient controversial [[Philosopher/Legends|philosophers]] and lawgivers of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The other three Sages were [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]], [[Yanjon/Legends|Yanjon]] and [[Faya/Legends|Faya]].<ref name="CL" /> Braata encouraged the study of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Beware the Sith">''[[Star Wars: Beware the Sith]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Braatastatue.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Statue of Sistros incorrectly identified as Braata in ''Star Wars Galaxies''.]]
In the now defunct MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', all four statues of the Sages of Dwartii could be collected. However, the statue that was labeled as Braata's in ''Galaxies''<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> was identified as Sistros' effigy by both ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and the bronze statues set "Sistros and Braata" produced by [[Sideshow Collectibles]].<ref name="SSC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.sideshowtoy.com/collectibles/product-archive/?sku=7232|text=Sistros and Braata: Secret Origins of the Sith|work=SideshowCollectibles.com|archiveurl=https://archive.is/6otEg}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]], administrator of the [[Holocron continuity database]] at [[Lucasfilm]], later stated that the Sideshow identification was correct.<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/382980658861076480|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@reeldefiction Sideshow Sistros and Braata is correct. Yanjon & Faya are two other statues, though neither has yet to be specifically ID'd.|archivedate=20190722093252}}</ref>
